c74object.name: evi_svfs_lto
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs_lto.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs_lto.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs_lto.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_svfs_filters.genexpr
About this File:
Using this require file you can access coefficients selectors for all LTO SVF filters in evieve with corresponding all-in-one filter sections. This file also includes all-in-one parametric EQ filter blocks.

entry.name: svfSectionCoeff ( )
entry.description:
General coefficients calculator for the 11 available filter types using the LTO SVF
In 1: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type), see source code for listing
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 4: type=input: fullQ, Q
Return 1: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 2: a2, a2 coefficient
Return 3: a3, a3 coefficient
Return 4: m0, low mixing gain
Return 5: m1, band mixing gain
Return 6: m2, high mixing gain

entry.name: svfSectionCoeffNoTilde ( )
entry.description:
A gen (no tilde) version of 'svfSectionCoeff()' for using at schedular rate
In 1: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type), see source code for listing
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 4: type=input: fullQ, Q
In 5: type=param (optional): AUDIO_SR, default: 48000, You must pass in the audio samplerate for usage in gen (no tilde)
Return 1: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 2: a2, a2 coefficient
Return 3: a3, a3 coefficient
Return 4: m0, low mixing gain
Return 5: m1, band mixing gain
Return 6: m2, high mixing gain

entry.name: eviFilterLto ( )
entry.description:
All-in-one coefficients and filter section for the 11 LTO filter types
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: db, Gain in dB
In 4: type=input: Q, Q
In 5: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type), see source code for listing
In 6: type=param (optional): smooth, default: 0, If > 0, ms smoothing time of required mixing gains
